title: Tenant-scoped AuditPath milestone orchestration and evidence bridge
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Deliver a milestone orchestration layer ('AuditPath') to coordinate tenant-scoped SOC2/ISO evidence collection, SSO/SAML cutover checkpoints, and per-tenant audit-log retention gates. This ticket defines the milestone map, evidence bridge automation, on-call rotation around cutovers, and measurement signals to declare gate pass/fail. The orchestration will integrate with the Console rollouts UI, the Evidence Pipeline, and the Dedicated onboarding flow so that enterprise customers have clear pass criteria and automated evidence handoff to auditors.
tasks: Define milestone phases and exit criteria: Discovery -> Pre-assertion -> Evidence Staging -> Audit Validation -> Cutover -> Post-assertion
Design tenant-scoped retention policy model and UI knobs (per-tenant retention + customer opt-in windows)
Implement evidence-bridge microservice to pull artifacts from S3/BigQuery and package into signed bundles
Add milestone state and timestamps to Console (per-customer milestone timeline widget)
Create runbook for cutover day with oncall rotation and escalation matrix
Instrument burnup/burn-down metrics and evidence velocity dashboard in Console Analytics
Build automated checks: SSO configuration health, audit-log ingestion rate, evidence completeness scoring
Coordinate end-to-end test with Dedicated and Private teams (dry-run with a staging tenant)
Prepare customer-facing checklist and onboarding playbook for CSMs

decisions: Use a signed ZIP manifest format for evidence bundles (manifest.v1.json + artifacts).
Milestone gating thresholds: evidence completeness >= 95%, SSO test pass for 2/3 saml flows, audit-log ingestion >= 99% of expected events over 72h.
Oncall rotation: Assurance SRE + Product lead for cutover day, fallback to Security on incident > P1.
Expose per-tenant retention policy as a Console toggle with minimum enforced retention in Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows per-tenant milestone timeline with timestamps and owner links
Evidence-bridge produces signed bundles that validate against manifest.v1.json schema
Automated gate checks run and produce pass/fail status in Console during a staging dry-run
Runbook validated by SRE and Security; oncall rotation schedule created and published
